description: Obras de generación de electricidad is a dataset listed in Argentine national open data portal (datos.gob.ar), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Energía. Listado de obras vigentes que se desarrollan con aporte de fondos del Estado Nacional. Incluye obras de centrales térmicas, nucleares, hidroeléctricas y de energías renovables, si las hubiere. Coverage: Argentina. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Energía. Its tags are Centrales, Energías renovables, Hidroeléctricas, Nucleares, Obras. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ar-portal.
